root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `H5O__fsinfo_decode()` may execute `vers = *p++`, it must establish that the later FSINFO message body still contains one readable byte, i.e. `p + 1 <= p_end` at the version-byte guard. On the stock PoC the later descriptor arrives with `p_size = 0`, so `p == p_end` and the vulnerable original still reaches the protected version read. The fixed original is guarded on that case, and the adjacent witness `aligned_fsinfo_body8_exact_chunk_fit` executes the same protected read with the predicate true.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing source-level obligation is the one-byte availability check at the version guard in `H5O__fsinfo_decode`, not a sink-side relation measured after the read has already occurred.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original trace records `fsinfo_version_guard.version_read_end=0x6070000003ec` and `body_end_exclusive=0x6070000003eb`, so the required predicate is violated while the protected `fsinfo_version_read` event still executes. The fixed original records the same zero-byte boundary but omits the protected read (guarded). The aligned witness `aligned_fsinfo_body8_exact_chunk_fit` executes the protected read on both sides with `version_read_end=0x6070000003e9 <= body_end_exclusive=0x6070000003f0`, supplying the genuine fixed-side witness.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, the vulnerable original consumes one byte for `vers = *p++` even though the later FSINFO body has no readable bytes left, so the read end lies beyond the message body's exclusive end.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `fsinfo_version_read.version_read_end=0x6070000003ec > fsinfo_version_read.body_end_exclusive=0x6070000003eb` at the sink event.

nodes.description: When the later FSINFO message header is recorded, its descriptor body size is zero, so the later lazy decode is handed an empty FSINFO body.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `fsinfo_descriptor_record.descriptor_body_size=0`.

edges.relation: The same message-body cursor `p` evaluated at the missing version-byte guard is the pointer immediately dereferenced by the subsequent `vers = *p++` sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `fsinfo_version_guard.version_ptr_before == fsinfo_version_read.version_ptr_before == 0x6070000003eb`.

edges.relation: The later FSINFO body pointer passed by `H5O_LOAD_NATIVE` reaches `H5O__fsinfo_decode()` unchanged and becomes the `p` value checked at the version-byte guard.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `fsinfo_decode_dispatch.dispatch_body_ptr == fsinfo_version_guard.version_ptr_before == 0x6070000003eb`.

edges.relation: The same later-FSINFO descriptor body pointer recorded by `H5O__chunk_deserialize()` is later presented to `H5O_LOAD_NATIVE` as `idx_msg->raw` for the lazy decode that reaches `H5O__fsinfo_decode()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `fsinfo_descriptor_record.descriptor_body_ptr == fsinfo_decode_dispatch.dispatch_body_ptr == 0x6070000003eb`.
